observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher leads the class through continuous physical demonstration while dancing alongside the students. She combines vocal encouragement and body language to guide the group through the choreography.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher and students perform a soukous choreography routine together in a studio.

what_works: Continuous demonstration allows students to follow along visually.
what_hinders: Lack of verbal breakdown or counts makes it harder to learn step-by-step.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor and students performing synchronized footwork and arm movements in a studio setting.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot placement or weight transfer details
